svg.aria-label: I build things that sense, decide and move. Right now that means a Jetson-powered robot that I'm teaching to map a room. I write the SLAM stack myself, starting from the raw LiDAR bytes, then benchmark it against the production tools. Alongside it runs a Gazebo digital twin, so the same code is tested in simulation before it touches the hardware. Every project here is written as an open research log: what I tried, what broke and what I learned.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Ubuntu, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
